svg.title: Pump — petrol pump robot
svg.desc: An emerald robot whose body is a vintage petrol pump cabinet with a number window, whose head is a lidded glass measure with fuel in its foot and two eyes on a band inside, with a ribbed hose arm ending in a nozzle, a ring jointed arm with a pincer, and short legs on flat feet.
